title: Bountiful Market Updated: November 2025 Position Report
summary: Bountiful platform updated with Almond Board of California November 2025 position report data.
body_markdown:
[Bountiful Market](https://app.bountiful.ag/market) is updated with new data from the[November 2025 Almond Board of California position report.](https://www.almonds.org/sites/default/files/2025-12/2025.11_PosRpt_7260.pdf)


[Log in to Market](https://app.bountiful.ag/market?utm_source=hs_email&utm_medium=email&_hsenc=p2ANqtz-8PRRz3tq1KjMn_JRldh4XFE0mAwGkAQlsf5S2aTEmLtJPnTZ1PfEzShRImde2FkCrmKE5f)


on the[Bountiful platform](http://app.bountiful.ag/) for your:


- Monthly Shipments
- Carry-out trends
- Crop Receipts by Variety
- Total Marketable Supply, Shipments vs Commitments


---


###
📈 Almond Crop Receipts down over 2024


November's position report marks the fourth of the 2025/2026 marketing year. Crop receipts to date: 2,187,599,257 lbs


down -6.60%


over last year.

### 📈 Crop Receipt Projections


Following the December position report, we'll begin running a forward projection on ABC form 1 crop receipts every month to get an idea of the total size of the crop.


The methodology we use for our crop receipt projections differs from our


[in-season machine learning forecasts](https://medium.com/@BountifulAg/forget-everything-you-know-about-forecasting-81b28ca05d2d?utm_source=hs_email&utm_medium=email&_hsenc=p2ANqtz-8PRRz3tq1KjMn_JRldh4XFE0mAwGkAQlsf5S2aTEmLtJPnTZ1PfEzShRImde2FkCrmKE5f) . Our 2025 in-season forecasts are complete and have not been updated since we released a final forecast in July.
